stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard labels [-h] {ensure,apply-from-markers} ...

`labels ensure` creates the labels the fleet uses, each with the repo's own gh
account, unless they exist: <user>:orchestrator, <user>:awaiting-cos and
<user>:awaiting-user. Idempotent. Run it when a repo joins.

positional arguments:
  {ensure,apply-from-markers}
    ensure              Create the missing labels (every watched repo by
                        default)
    apply-from-markers  Label the open PRs and issues whose first body line
                        says MERGE: captain|automatic (a person's command; a
                        dry run unless --apply)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
